notes: The scanner menu item id is action_import_clipboard, but its title is 'Import from file…' and it opens the image picker, not the clipboard. shortcuts.xml is also a U11 file; the Toggle shortcut is recorded here only because the file is a U10 source, and its behavior belongs to U11. The Add Profile 'Scan QR code' entry lives in U02 profile_manager_menu.xml, and the drawer About entry lives in U01 navigation_main.xml; both appear as flow starts, not as U10 controls. About is a fragment inside MainActivity, so the About screen node is the fragment container; the drawer itself belongs to U01. about.html encodes the Max Lv mailto address with HTML entities, and it decodes to max.c.lv@gmail.com. HarmonyOS has no barcode decoder and no ScannerActivity, so the scan and image-import cases are missing. CameraX, the runtime permission dialog, the launcher shortcut and the Google Play OSS licences UI are Android platform surfaces, so those cases are android-only. HarmonyOS About (pages/About.ets) shows the app version, the native core version and the licence, so the version and licence case is implemented. The Android title format, the about.html body, the clickable links and the drawer route are not ported, so those cases are partial or missing. The About toolbar icon case is included as TC-U10-24. The HarmonyOS About page has a Back control, and U01 records the drawer as missing, so that case is missing. TC-U10-21 reads the exported profile JSON because the editor has no control for the UDP-DNS field. TC-U10-23 uses a test build with an empty about.html to observe the hidden body. The parity reference lists launcher shortcuts under both Missing and Android-only surfaces; this spec uses android-only for the shortcut surface.
